_note: Name approved in chat 2026-11-22 (APR-001). Whisker & Wag dropped: .com and most variants taken. Copywriter uses voice rules below.
name: Good Leash Co.
name_note: Name leans dog; copy and collections must still welcome cat parents equally.

name_candidates.name: Whisker & Wag
name_candidates.rationale: Signals dogs + cats from day one

name_check_required: Trademark search (USPTO TESS), .com availability, social handles — before approval
audience: US pet parents of dogs and cats who want practical products that solve everyday problems

do: Lead with the everyday problem the product solves
Use plain, specific language and real specs
Address the reader as a fellow pet parent
dont: No health, vet, cure, or anxiety-treatment claims
No fake urgency, countdowns, or invented stock levels
No competitor brand names or trademarks
voice.sample_line: Tired of muddy paws on the couch? This mat traps dirt and water at the door, so the mess stays put.
